Make a statement with this chic and glamorous V-neck evening dress. The sleeveless design allows for ease of movement, while the high-waisted A-line silhouette accentuates the waistline for a flattering fit. Adorned with sparkling sequins, this gown is perfect for adding a touch of glamour to any special occasion.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
